nl_text: The database name is rschema_0377, and it contains three tables: article, tag, and article_tag_association. The article table has a primary key consisting of the article title and post ID, and it is used to store information about articles. The tag table has a primary key consisting of the tag category and tag ID, and it is used to store information about tags. The article_tag_association table has a primary key consisting of the tag ID and post ID, and it is used to store information about the association between articles and tags. The table also has two foreign keys, fk_post_id and fk_tag_id, which reference the post ID and tag ID columns in the article and tag tables, respectively. The foreign keys have ON DELETE CASCADE and ON UPDATE CASCADE rules, which means that if a post ID or tag ID is deleted or updated in the article or tag tables, the corresponding row in the article_tag_association table will also be deleted or updated.
gold_question:
This database model is part of a content management system (CMS) and is used to manage the relationship between articles (posts) and tags (tags)

Main functions

1 Article and tag relationship management: Through the post_id and tag_id fields, a many-to-many relationship between articles and multiple tags can be achieved, allowing an article to have multiple tags, and a tag can also be associated with multiple articles
2 Creation time record: Through the created_at field, the creation time of each article tag association is recorded to facilitate subsequent time sorting and filtering
3 Data integrity: Through the Foreign key constraints fk_post_id and fk_tag_id, the data consistency of articles and tags is ensured to prevent invalid association records
4 Data query: You can quickly query all tags of an article, or query all articles associated with a tag, supporting efficient search and filtering functions
